title: Winter Clothes Distribution – Kamalapur Slum
description: Distributing warm sweaters, jackets and socks to 300+ low-income families living near Kamalapur before the cold wave arrives.
volunteerGuidelines: Please arrive 15 minutes before the scheduled time at the designated location.
Wear comfortable clothing suitable for physical social work and distribution.
Bring any pre-coordinated relief packages or distribution items if requested.
Sort clothes by size and gender at the sorting desk before distribution begins.
Hand over items respectfully and never take photos of recipients without consent.
Follow the token system so every family receives items in an orderly queue.

title: Blanket Relief Drive – Kurigram Char Areas
description: Delivering 500 thick blankets to riverine char communities in Kurigram, one of the coldest regions of Bangladesh.
volunteerGuidelines: Please arrive 15 minutes before the scheduled time at the designated location.
Wear comfortable clothing suitable for physical social work and distribution.
Bring any pre-coordinated relief packages or distribution items if requested.
Dress in warm layers and carry a water bottle; boat travel to the chars can be cold and windy.
Wear a life jacket at all times during river crossings.
Prioritise elderly people, children and pregnant women during distribution.

title: Winter Relief Night Walk – Street Dwellers
description: A late-night volunteer walk covering Gulistan, Paltan and Motijheel to give blankets and warm clothes to people sleeping on the streets.
volunteerGuidelines: Please arrive 15 minutes before the scheduled time at the designated location.
Wear comfortable clothing suitable for physical social work and distribution.
Bring any pre-coordinated relief packages or distribution items if requested.
Move in groups of at least four and stay with your team leader at all times.
Carry a torch or phone light and keep your phone charged for emergencies.
Do not wake sleeping people; place items gently beside them or ask nearby people to pass them on.

title: Sweater Collection & Sorting Day
location: University of Scholars Campus, Banani, Dhaka
description: Collect, wash-check, sort and pack donated winter clothes ready for upcoming relief distributions across Bangladesh.
volunteerGuidelines: Please arrive 15 minutes before the scheduled time at the designated location.
Wear comfortable clothing suitable for physical social work and distribution.
Bring any pre-coordinated relief packages or distribution items if requested.
Wear gloves and a mask while handling used clothes.
Reject torn, stained or unusable items politely and set them aside for recycling.
Label each packed box with size, gender and quantity using the provided marker.

title: Winter Relief for Tea Garden Workers
description: Providing jackets, caps and blankets to tea garden workers and their families in the cold northeastern hills.
volunteerGuidelines: Please arrive 15 minutes before the scheduled time at the designated location.
Wear comfortable clothing suitable for physical social work and distribution.
Bring any pre-coordinated relief packages or distribution items if requested.
Respect local customs and speak politely with the workers and community leaders.
Wear sturdy shoes; paths inside the tea estate can be muddy and uneven.
Coordinate with the estate representative before starting distribution.

title: Warm Kids Campaign – School Uniform Sweaters
description: Gifting school sweaters and warm socks to 250 primary school students from low-income families.
volunteerGuidelines: Please arrive 15 minutes before the scheduled time at the designated location.
Wear comfortable clothing suitable for physical social work and distribution.
Bring any pre-coordinated relief packages or distribution items if requested.
Be patient and friendly with children; help them try on sweaters for the right fit.
Follow the school's child-safety rules and never take children out of the school premises.
Take photos only with the school's permission.

title: Tree Plantation Day – Hatirjheel Banks
description: Planting 500 native saplings such as neem, krishnachura and jarul along the Hatirjheel embankment to improve air quality.
volunteerGuidelines: Please arrive 15 minutes before the scheduled time at the designated location.
Wear comfortable clothing suitable for physical social work and distribution.
Bring any pre-coordinated relief packages or distribution items if requested.
Wear old clothes and closed shoes as you will be working with soil.
Bring a hat, sunscreen and a reusable water bottle.
Plant saplings at the marked spots and water each one right after planting.

title: Green Campus Initiative – 300 Saplings
location: University of Scholars Campus, Banani, Dhaka
description: Students and staff come together to plant fruit and shade trees around campus and set up a care roster for each tree.
volunteerGuidelines: Please arrive 15 minutes before the scheduled time at the designated location.
Wear comfortable clothing suitable for physical social work and distribution.
Bring any pre-coordinated relief packages or distribution items if requested.
Bring a trowel or small spade if you have one; tools will also be provided.
Sign up for the tree-care roster so each sapling is watered for the next three months.
Attach the name tag to the sapling you plant.

title: Mangrove Restoration – Sundarbans Fringe
description: Replanting mangrove seedlings on eroded riverbanks to protect coastal villages from storm surges.
volunteerGuidelines: Please arrive 15 minutes before the scheduled time at the designated location.
Wear comfortable clothing suitable for physical social work and distribution.
Bring any pre-coordinated relief packages or distribution items if requested.
Wear waterproof boots or be ready to work barefoot in muddy tidal soil.
Follow the local guide's instructions on planting depth and spacing.
Use mosquito repellent and carry safe drinking water; the area is remote.

title: Roadside Plantation Drive – Gazipur Highway
description: Planting shade trees along a highway stretch with guards to protect each sapling from livestock.
volunteerGuidelines: Please arrive 15 minutes before the scheduled time at the designated location.
Wear comfortable clothing suitable for physical social work and distribution.
Bring any pre-coordinated relief packages or distribution items if requested.
Wear a high-visibility vest (provided) and stay on the designated work side of the road.
Never cross the highway alone; follow the safety marshals.
Help install bamboo tree guards around each sapling.

title: Dhanmondi Lake Cleanup Drive
description: Cleaning litter and plastic waste from the lakeside walkways and shoreline, then sorting recyclables.
volunteerGuidelines: Please arrive 15 minutes before the scheduled time at the designated location.
Wear comfortable clothing suitable for physical social work and distribution.
Bring any pre-coordinated relief packages or distribution items if requested.
Wear gloves and closed shoes; gloves and trash bags will be provided.
Do not pick up sharp objects or medical waste with bare hands; report them to the team leader.
Separate plastic, glass and paper into the colour-coded bags.

title: Buriganga Riverbank Cleanup
description: A large-scale volunteer effort to remove solid waste from the Buriganga riverbank and raise awareness about river pollution.
volunteerGuidelines: Please arrive 15 minutes before the scheduled time at the designated location.
Wear comfortable clothing suitable for physical social work and distribution.
Bring any pre-coordinated relief packages or distribution items if requested.
Wear a face mask, gloves and rubber boots; the area has strong odours and slippery ground.
Stay away from the water's edge unless assigned and supervised.
Wash your hands thoroughly after the cleanup and take the provided sanitiser.

title: Laboni Beach Cleanup – Cox's Bazar
description: Collecting plastic bottles, nets and packaging from the world's longest natural sea beach and weighing the waste collected.
volunteerGuidelines: Please arrive 15 minutes before the scheduled time at the designated location.
Wear comfortable clothing suitable for physical social work and distribution.
Bring any pre-coordinated relief packages or distribution items if requested.
Wear a hat, sunglasses and sunscreen; the beach has little shade.
Do not swim during the cleanup and keep away from rough waves.
Record the waste type and weight at the data desk for the cleanup report.

title: Clean Neighbourhood Day – Mirpur 10
description: Sweeping streets, clearing blocked drains and painting wall murals with local residents and shopkeepers.
volunteerGuidelines: Please arrive 15 minutes before the scheduled time at the designated location.
Wear comfortable clothing suitable for physical social work and distribution.
Bring any pre-coordinated relief packages or distribution items if requested.
Wear gloves and a mask when clearing drains and garbage piles.
Stay alert to traffic and work only in the sections cordoned off by the team.
Talk politely with shopkeepers and residents; encourage them to use bins.

title: Winter Donation Fair – Books & Clothes
description: A public donation stall collecting books, clothes, shoes and school supplies from the community for families in need.
volunteerGuidelines: Please arrive 15 minutes before the scheduled time at the designated location.
Wear comfortable clothing suitable for physical social work and distribution.
Bring any pre-coordinated relief packages or distribution items if requested.
Greet donors warmly and give a receipt slip for every donation.
Record donated items in the logbook with quantity and category.
Accept only clean, usable items and politely decline damaged goods.

title: Blood Donation Camp
location: University of Scholars Auditorium, Banani, Dhaka
description: A campus blood donation camp in partnership with a licensed blood bank to support patients with thalassemia and accident victims.
volunteerGuidelines: Please arrive 15 minutes before the scheduled time at the designated location.
Wear comfortable clothing suitable for physical social work and distribution.
Bring any pre-coordinated relief packages or distribution items if requested.
Help with registration and guide donors to the screening desk; do not give medical advice.
Make sure donors have eaten and are well hydrated before donating.
Keep donor information confidential and follow the medical team's instructions.

title: Zakat & Cash Aid Distribution for Widows
description: Verified cash support and grocery vouchers handed to widows and single mothers to help them through the winter months.
volunteerGuidelines: Please arrive 15 minutes before the scheduled time at the designated location.
Wear comfortable clothing suitable for physical social work and distribution.
Bring any pre-coordinated relief packages or distribution items if requested.
Dress modestly and treat every beneficiary with dignity and privacy.
Verify each beneficiary's token and ID against the approved list before handing over aid.
Do not discuss amounts or personal details outside the venue.

title: Toy & Storybook Donation for Orphans
description: Donating toys, storybooks and art supplies to children at a local orphanage, with a fun afternoon of storytelling and games.
volunteerGuidelines: Please arrive 15 minutes before the scheduled time at the designated location.
Wear comfortable clothing suitable for physical social work and distribution.
Bring any pre-coordinated relief packages or distribution items if requested.
Bring new or like-new toys and books suitable for ages 4 to 14.
Follow the orphanage's child-protection rules; stay in common areas only.
Prepare a short story or game to share with the children.

title: Free Hot Meal Distribution – Dhaka Medical College
location: Dhaka Medical College Hospital Gate, Dhaka
description: Serving hot khichuri meals to patients' attendants and the homeless outside the hospital.
volunteerGuidelines: Please arrive 15 minutes before the scheduled time at the designated location.
Wear comfortable clothing suitable for physical social work and distribution.
Bring any pre-coordinated relief packages or distribution items if requested.
Wash your hands and wear gloves, a mask and an apron while serving food.
Serve in an orderly queue, giving priority to the elderly, women and children.
Collect used plates and dispose of them in the bins provided to keep the area clean.

title: Iftar-Style Community Meal for Rickshaw Pullers
description: Providing a nutritious evening meal packet with rice, egg curry and fruit to 400 rickshaw pullers and day labourers.
volunteerGuidelines: Please arrive 15 minutes before the scheduled time at the designated location.
Wear comfortable clothing suitable for physical social work and distribution.
Bring any pre-coordinated relief packages or distribution items if requested.
Pack meals in sealed containers with a spoon and tissue; follow the packing checklist.
Keep food covered until distribution and maintain hygiene at all times.
Distribute politely along the road without blocking traffic.

title: Ration Pack Distribution – Flood-Prone Villages
description: Distributing monthly ration packs containing rice, lentils, oil, salt and potatoes to 200 families affected by river erosion.
volunteerGuidelines: Please arrive 15 minutes before the scheduled time at the designated location.
Wear comfortable clothing suitable for physical social work and distribution.
Bring any pre-coordinated relief packages or distribution items if requested.
Be ready to lift and carry sacks; wear comfortable shoes and use proper lifting posture.
Check each family's coupon against the beneficiary list before giving a pack.
Stay with your group during village visits and respect the local leaders' guidance.

title: Weekend Food Share – Street Children
description: A weekly food share serving breakfast and a healthy snack to street children, with a short hygiene awareness session.
volunteerGuidelines: Please arrive 15 minutes before the scheduled time at the designated location.
Wear comfortable clothing suitable for physical social work and distribution.
Bring any pre-coordinated relief packages or distribution items if requested.
Be kind and patient with the children and speak to them with respect.
Do not give food that may be unsafe; use only the prepared packs.
Help lead the hand-washing demonstration before the meal begins.

title: Free Medical Camp – Savar Villages
description: A one-day free medical camp offering general check-ups, blood pressure and sugar tests, and free basic medicines.
volunteerGuidelines: Please arrive 15 minutes before the scheduled time at the designated location.
Wear comfortable clothing suitable for physical social work and distribution.
Bring any pre-coordinated relief packages or distribution items if requested.
Help with patient registration, queue management and guiding patients to the doctors.
Do not give any medicine or medical advice; leave that to the licensed doctors.
Keep patient information confidential and wear a mask and gloves where required.

title: Eye Care & Cataract Screening Camp
description: Free eye tests, reading glasses and cataract surgery referrals for elderly residents with partner ophthalmologists.
volunteerGuidelines: Please arrive 15 minutes before the scheduled time at the designated location.
Wear comfortable clothing suitable for physical social work and distribution.
Bring any pre-coordinated relief packages or distribution items if requested.
Assist elderly patients patiently, holding their arm while walking and guiding them to each station.
Keep the testing area quiet and well-lit; do not move equipment.
Note referrals accurately on each patient's slip so no one is missed.

title: Women's Health & Hygiene Awareness Camp
description: Health check-ups, a menstrual hygiene session and free hygiene kits for women and adolescent girls.
volunteerGuidelines: Please arrive 15 minutes before the scheduled time at the designated location.
Wear comfortable clothing suitable for physical social work and distribution.
Bring any pre-coordinated relief packages or distribution items if requested.
Female volunteers will be prioritised at the registration and counselling desks.
Maintain strict privacy and a respectful, non-judgmental attitude at all times.
Distribute hygiene kits discreetly and answer only basic, approved questions.

title: Winter Illness Prevention & Vaccination Awareness
description: Free flu and pneumonia screening, health talks on cold-season diseases, and referrals to government vaccination centres.
volunteerGuidelines: Please arrive 15 minutes before the scheduled time at the designated location.
Wear comfortable clothing suitable for physical social work and distribution.
Bring any pre-coordinated relief packages or distribution items if requested.
Use hand sanitiser frequently and wear a mask throughout the camp.
Distribute awareness leaflets and explain them in simple Bangla.
Direct anyone with severe symptoms straight to the on-site medical team.

title: Free Evening School for Working Children
description: A weekly evening class teaching Bangla, English and basic maths to children who work during the day.
volunteerGuidelines: Please arrive 15 minutes before the scheduled time at the designated location.
Wear comfortable clothing suitable for physical social work and distribution.
Bring any pre-coordinated relief packages or distribution items if requested.
Prepare a short lesson plan in advance and bring simple teaching aids.
Be patient, encouraging and respectful with every child regardless of their level.
Follow the centre's child-protection policy and never ask for children's personal contact details.

title: Career & Skills Workshop for Underprivileged Students
location: University of Scholars Seminar Hall, Banani, Dhaka
description: A free workshop on CV writing, basic computer skills and scholarship opportunities for HSC and university students.
volunteerGuidelines: Please arrive 15 minutes before the scheduled time at the designated location.
Wear comfortable clothing suitable for physical social work and distribution.
Bring any pre-coordinated relief packages or distribution items if requested.
Dress in smart-casual attire as you will be mentoring and guiding students.
Bring a laptop if you will help with the computer skills session.
Offer honest, practical and supportive advice; avoid making promises about jobs or scholarships.

title: Mobile Library & Reading Day
location: Char Kukri Mukri Primary School, Bhola
description: Setting up a mobile library with 600 storybooks and leading read-aloud sessions for rural school students.
volunteerGuidelines: Please arrive 15 minutes before the scheduled time at the designated location.
Wear comfortable clothing suitable for physical social work and distribution.
Bring any pre-coordinated relief packages or distribution items if requested.
Handle books carefully and help with sorting and cataloguing them by reading level.
Read aloud clearly and slowly, using expressions to keep children engaged.
Pack up all books at the end and tally them to ensure none are lost.

title: School Supply Kit Distribution
description: Giving school bags with notebooks, pencils, geometry boxes and water bottles to 300 students ahead of the new academic term.
volunteerGuidelines: Please arrive 15 minutes before the scheduled time at the designated location.
Wear comfortable clothing suitable for physical social work and distribution.
Bring any pre-coordinated relief packages or distribution items if requested.
Pack each kit following the checklist so every child receives identical items.
Distribute by class in an orderly line with help from the class teachers.
Encourage students warmly and avoid comparing or singling out any child.
